brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four bases placed: piece:0,0,0;full, piece:1,0,0;full, piece:0,-1,0;full, piece:1,-1,0;full in a 2x2 cluster

finish.summary: Four-cell base cluster built (LOOSE_BODY warning only). Attempts to route a single irrigation run through all four bases were refused with ROUTE_NO_PATH; no water pipe currently passes through cells.
